title: Package the three styles as a Claude Code plugin
description: Prepare this repo for the opum marketplace. Add .claude-plugin/plugin.json and move the three style files into output-styles/, where Claude Code discovers plugin output styles. Whether the styles ship standalone or fold into opum-output-styles is pending with the operator's design session (via opum-agent); this task builds the in-repo plugin either way and cuts no tag and touches no other repo.

acceptanceCriteria.text: claude plugin validate exits 0 on the repo root
The three style files live under output-styles/ with their frontmatter names unchanged
A session started with the repo loaded as a plugin lists all three styles under the plugin namespace
harness/config/contracts.json and harness tests point at the new paths and the harness test suite passes
README and the install runbook document the plugin install and the namespaced outputStyle value, keeping the manual copy path
